blocks.content: Quiz: You're building a user dashboard that shows a list of tasks, a calendar, and notifications. All three update when the user completes a task. Why might React be a good choice here?
Tap an option below to answer:
React automatically updates all three sections when the task data changes
React keeps the UI in sync with your data.
React keeps the UI in sync with your data.
React makes the page load faster than plain JavaScript
Speed is not React's main advantage.
Speed is not React's main advantage.
React prevents you from writing any JavaScript
React is a JavaScript library, not a replacement for it.
React is a JavaScript library, not a replacement for it.
React eliminates the need for HTML and CSS
React uses JSX (which looks like HTML) and still needs CSS.
React uses JSX (which looks like HTML) and still needs CSS.
